import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
from se_harness import __version__
from se_harness.cli import build_parser
assert __version__ == "0.19.0"
rows = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
results = []
for name, args in rows:
    if args == ["--version"]:
        try: build_parser().parse_args(args)
        except SystemExit as e: assert e.code == 0
    else:
        parsed = build_parser().parse_args(args)
        if hasattr(parsed, "target"): assert parsed.target in ("REPO", "PROJECT")
    results.append({"file": name, "args": args, "result": "pass"})
print(json.dumps({"version": __version__, "isolated": sys.flags.isolated, "python": sys.executable,
 "cwd": str(Path.cwd()), "case_count": len(results), "results": results}, indent=2))
